output.summary: formatPrice gains a required currency parameter and tax gains an optional rate parameter. Callers that import them pass the new arguments. Several other edits (a same-named method call, a legacy label, a config currency) look unrelated to these contracts and need separate checking.

groups.title: formatPrice gains a currency parameter
groups.description: The signature and output of formatPrice in src/price.ts change, and the currency is now required. Check that the output format change is intended for all consumers.

groups.title: TypeScript callers pass a currency
groups.description: Checkout, invoice, receipt and the re-export alias caller now pass 'USD'. Check that none should use another currency, such as the one in config.json.

groups.title: tax gains a rate parameter
groups.description: tax in tax.py now takes an optional rate defaulting to the old 0.1. Check that the default preserves existing behavior.

groups.title: Python callers pass a rate
groups.description: order_total and refund now pass a rate of 0.2, which differs from the default. Check that this rate change is intended.

groups.title: Edits unrelated to the new parameters
groups.description: These look unrelated to the contract changes: calls to same-named methods, a legacy label and a config currency switch to EUR. Check that the config change is intended and consistent with the hard-coded 'USD' callers.

edgeVerdicts.reason: The call is on an Fmt receiver, so it targets the Fmt.formatPrice method, not the function in src/price.ts.

inferredRelationships.explanation: The config currency changed alongside a function that now takes a currency, while callers hard-code 'USD'.
